pr_title: roachtest: network/client-connection-timeout fix port assignment bug
pr_body:
Previously, this test incorrectly did not select a port for the SQL client when starting up the server, which would cause this test to fail when the client machine attempted to connect. To address this, this patch sets SQL listen port when starting the cluster to the default value.

Fixes: #117869

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/117884)

> if it needs to be backported, then let's do this separately from this PR

Thats a good point. It doesn't need to be backported just yet (we've been holding off to shake out flakes) but will be eventually. I can put a PR out in that case then.
